title: Under Ninja Manga Goes on 4-Week Hiatus
content: This year's 52nd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that Kengo Hanazawa 's Under Ninja manga will go on a four-week hiatus. The manga will return in the magazine's combined fourth and fifth issue of 2027, which will actually ship on December 28.
author: ANN

title: Exoprimal Game Ends Service in September 2027
content: CAPCOM announced on Wednesday that its Exoprimal team-based action game will end service on September 29, 2027. Sales of Survival Pass Premium Tiers ended on Tuesday. The game, DLC, and all other tie-in products will be delisted from stores on March 30. The game will no longer be playable after the end of service.
author: ANN

title: Melty Blood:Twi-Lumina 2D Fighter Game's New Trailer Confirms Crossplay
content: Type-Moon 's Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina 2D fighter game revealed new features as well as crossplay capability in its main trailer on Wednesday. TYPE-MOON describes the game: MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray!
author: ANN

title: Bandai Card Games Launches Digimon Alysion Game
content: Bandai Card Games released its Digimon Alysion mobile card game on Wednesday. The game is available for iOS and Android devices in 183 territories. The free-to-play game features online card battles.
author: ANN

title: Nobunaga's Ambition Series Gets New Game Next March
content: Koei Tecmo announced on Wednesday that Nobunaga no Yabō: Hishou ( Nobunaga's Ambition: Hishou or Soaring), a new game in its Nobunaga's Ambition game franchise, will launch for the PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Windows via Steam on March 12.
author: ANN

title: 'Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2' Unveils Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Buncololi ’s Sasaki to Pii-chan ( Sasaki and Peeps ) reveals additional cast on Wednesday. The anime series premiered on October 7 and is currently airing on AT-X, Tokyo MX and BS Nippon Television, with the first episode broadcasting as a one-hour special.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sentimental Graffiti Remake Game Listed on March 25
content: The Animate retail chain is listing Sentimental Graffiti Remake (written as Sentimental Graffiti Re ), Entergram's remake of NEC Interchannel 's classic dating simulation game Sentimental Graffiti , for release on PlayStation 5 and Switch on March 25.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action 'The Long Summer of August 31' Series Trailer Unveils Cast, Staff, Disney+ Streaming, January 8 Debut
content: The official website for the live-action series of Ikkado Ito 's The Long Summer of August 31 ( August 31 no Long Summer ) manga unveiled a special trailer and key visual for the series on Thursday. The video announces the series' cast, staff, Disney+ streaming, and January 8 premiere date.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest Fall 2026 Anime Exposes the Real Problem Behind One-Punch Man
content: J.C. Staff isn’t the problem behind One-Punch Man ‘s disaster, as the studio’s latest anime, currently airing weekly on Crunchyroll, is doing wonders with its animation. Fans often blame J.C. Staff for the decline in quality that plagued the second and third seasons of One-Punch Man .
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You’re Waiting for Re:Zero Season 5
content: Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World – is easily one of the biggest anime on Crunchyroll, and it continues to get more popular thanks to its sequel seasons. 2026 was a huge year for fans since the anime not only commemorated its 10th anniversary , but also aired its Season 4 in two cours.
author: ComicBook
